newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on some late buying and selling interest in line with the mixed sentiment in Japanese prices, brokers said on Monday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe also ended mixed after the spot August months expired with a large number of deliveries.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives. But prices were narrowly mixed in the afternoon on some late buying and selling interest. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 fell one cent to 128.50 U.S. cents a kg.
November RSS1 rose one cent to 188.50 Singapore cents (US$1.34) a kg.
January/March was unchanged from last Friday's settlement of 181.50 Singapore cents (US$1.29) a kg.
